query:
SELECT topic, LENGTH(decision_makers) as makers_len, LENGTH(decision_outcome) as outcome_len, 
SUBSTRING(decision_makers, 1, 100) as makers_preview,
SUBSTRING(decision_outcome, 1, 100) as outcome_preview
FROM software_items 
WHERE section_type = 'decisions' AND software_category = 'software_ai'
LIMIT 3;
